content: zlib-rs 0.6.8 (Trifecta Tech Foundation): MSRV 1.75, license Zlib, pure Rust with some unsafe; inflate 7-13% faster than zlib-ng at 16B-64KB chunk sizes and 2-6% faster than Chromium zlib; AVX-512 expanded in 0.5.3; generally on-par-or-faster than zlib-ng; originally ISRG/Tweede golf, moved to Trifecta Nov 2024.
